title: Update a Volatile Register Field
shortDescription: Modify a masked field in a volatile register while preserving unrelated bits.

templates.notes: Read once, update the masked field, then write once.

visibleCases.name: set low field
visibleCases.displayInput:
volatile uint32_t reg = 0xFFFF0000u;
uint32_t old = reg_update_field(&reg, 0x0000000Fu, 0u, 5u);

visibleCases.name: replace shifted field
visibleCases.explanation: Value is shifted into the target field.

hiddenCases.name: truncate wide value
hiddenCases.explanation: Input value must be clipped by the mask.

hiddenCases.name: return previous value
hiddenCases.explanation: Callers may need the previous register state.
